policies.reason: treaty_05 acid-pipe quota met: Station 0 exchange continues, acid and sulfur terms hold.

market_modifiers.reason: Compliance restores the exchange lane; the foundry's pipe stock clears at normal terms again.
Sulfur supply resumes; the foundry's coal purchases return to prior terms.

policies.reason: treaty_05 acid-pipe quota missed: Station 0 buys pipes elsewhere; the sulfur-for-iron exchange stalls.

market_modifiers.reason: Station 0 sources acid-resistant pipe from other casters; foundry pipe sits unsold (lower effective price for the foundry).
Sulfur supply stalls; the foundry must pay more for coal to keep the cupola lit through the exchange gap.

policies.reason: treaty_10 labor accord upheld: shifts capped, workers fed, fuel allotment unchanged.

market_modifiers.reason: The council and the miners' union release the fuel allotment again after compliance.

policies.reason: treaty_10 labor accord violated (strike, overtime, or child labor on the charging floor): the council and the miners' union tighten the fuel allotment.

market_modifiers.reason: Lockouts and unannounced strikes reduce the foundry's fuel allotment; fuel demand rises as the shelter scrambles for replacement heat.

policies.reason: treaty_12 rail quota met: spikes and wheels delivered, coal and ore gondolas run on schedule.

market_modifiers.reason: Railway coal gondolas run to schedule again; coal terms ease back.
The corps takes the foundry's spikes again; the surplus clears at normal terms.

policies.reason: treaty_12 rail quota missed: the railway's coal and ore logistics tighten; the corps renegotiates terms.

market_modifiers.reason: Railway coal gondolas are reprioritized to the corps; coal for the shelter becomes scarcer and dearer.
The corps buys spikes elsewhere to keep the line open; the foundry's own spike stock moves slowly.
